article.title: Elección estilística consciente
article.part: Contraste y dominio C2 — 대조와 C2 고급 운용
article.chapter: Norma, estilo y elección avanzada C2 — 규범·문체·C2 고급 선택

claims.summary: The conscious stylistic choice involves selecting among possible grammatical and lexical forms based on social relationship, textual genre, communicative purpose, and tone.

claims.sectionKey: Una misma proposición puede expresarse con distintos estilos de habla, grados de condensación o fórmulas profesionales
claims.summary: The same proposition can be expressed with different speech styles, degrees of condensation, or professional formulas.

claims.sectionKey: 확인했습니다 pertenece al estilo formal cortés
claims.summary: 확인했습니다 belongs to the formal polite style and may be appropriate in reports, presentations, or professional interactions.

claims.sectionKey: 확인했어요 mantiene cortesía con un tono cotidiano
claims.summary: 확인했어요 maintains courtesy with a casual tone.
확인했어 belongs to 해체 and presupposes a relationship that allows for informal speech.

claims.sectionKey: 말씀드리겠습니다 can be natural in a formal presentation
claims.summary: 말씀드리겠습니다 can be natural in a formal presentation.

claims.sectionKey: 말할게요 comunica una relación y un tono diferentes
claims.summary: 말할게요 communicates a different relationship and tone.

claims.sectionKey: En un informe puede aparecer 확인했습니다 y con un amigo 확인했어
claims.summary: In a report 확인했습니다 may appear, while with a friend 확인했어 may be used.

claims.sectionKey: Le adjunto… encaja en muchos correos profesionales
claims.summary: Le adjunto fits in many professional emails.

claims.sectionKey: 파일 보냈어 can be much more natural in an informal conversation
claims.summary: 파일 보냈어 can be much more natural in an informal conversation.
교수님께 말씀드렸습니다 constructs a deferential orientation that is not reducible to changing a single word.
